entries.title: Done and Got it send the words you typed in a card's reply box
entries.body: Words left in a note's reply box were dropped when you pressed its Done or Got it button. They now go with the press, as they already do with a card's other buttons: to the card's author, or to your first mate when Done closes the task. This works on the Mac and on iPhone and iPad.
entries.noPicture: The card looks the same before and after; the fix is that the typed words now arrive with the press.
